newsitem.title: USA: LOCKHEED UNIT SIGNS $22 MLN CONTRACT.
newsitem.headline: LOCKHEED UNIT SIGNS $22 MLN CONTRACT.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp said Tuesday that it has signed a $22 million six-year contract to provide information technology services to PYA/Monarch Inc.
The contract, signed by Lockheed's Integrated Business Solutions unit, is a renewal of a previous contract, and includes mainframe processing and support, telecommunications and help desk services.
Privately-held PYA/Monarch is a foodservice distributor based in Greenville, SC. It reported $2.4 billion in annual sales in fiscal 1997.
Lockheed's core businesses span aeronautics, electronics, energy & environment, information and services, space and strategic missiles, telecommunications and systems integration.
